look: XORA site look (user asked to follow xora.xtinex.com): deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet gradient edges, fictional market lines that draw themselves in, calm eased motion

scenes.name: Signal from noise
scenes.desc: A jagged fictional price line draws across the dark, settles, and the XTINEX | XORA lockup appears.

scenes.name: Welcome
scenes.desc: Title: Welcome to XORA Futures Edge, a beginner course in crypto futures that starts from zero.

scenes.name: Who it is for
scenes.desc: Never traded? Three beginner situations appear as chips; every term is defined before it is used.

scenes.name: How a lesson works
scenes.desc: A lesson card assembles its five ways to learn: Watch, Read, Slides, Try it, Quiz, each lighting in turn.

scenes.name: Five phases
scenes.desc: A roadmap path draws through five phase nodes, 23 lessons and three checkpoints.

scenes.name: Demo only
scenes.desc: A live order button is switched off and replaced by Demo; no live trading, no real money, no keys.

scenes.name: Risk in view
scenes.desc: Leverage, fees and wrong signals are named; BUY, SELL and WAIT appear and WAIT is highlighted as valid.

scenes.name: By the end
scenes.desc: Four outcomes tick in one by one as a checklist.

scenes.name: Start lesson one
scenes.desc: End card: next up T01 What Is Cryptocurrency, with the education-only notice.
